units.summary: The company expects FAIR to help choose and scope its first proof of concept; the company leans toward freight document processing.
units.quote: Help to choose and scope the first proof of concept - the company leans towards freight document processing.

units.summary: The company expects technical advice on document extraction options, TMS API integration, and human-in-the-loop design.
units.quote: Technical advice on document extraction approach (OCR vs. vision language models), on how to integrate with the TMS API, and on human-in-the-loop design.

units.summary: The company expects an assessment of whether its WMS data is suitable for forecasting.
units.quote: An assessment of whether the WMS data is good enough for forecasting.

units.summary: The company expects guidance on an AI usage policy, GDPR, and AI Act obligations, especially for customer service.
units.quote: Guidance on an AI usage policy for staff, GDPR and AI Act obligations (especially for the customer service use case).

units.summary: The company may want a Master's thesis student for the forecasting topic in spring 2027.
units.quote: Possibly a Master's thesis student for the forecasting topic (spring 2027).

units.summary: The company expects help with a funding application if the proof of concept looks promising.
units.quote: Help with a funding application if the PoC looks promising.

units.topic: document extraction note and proof-of-concept outline
units.summary: Daniel is to prepare a short note on document extraction options and an outline for the proof of concept.
units.quote: Daniel: prepare a short note on document extraction options and a PoC outline.

units.topic: AI usage policy template and funding instruments
units.summary: Elina is to send an AI usage policy template and a list of funding instruments.
units.quote: Elina: send an AI usage policy template and a list of funding instruments.

units.topic: freight document sample for proof of concept
units.summary: Jari is to send an anonymised sample of 200 freight documents, covering multiple types, sites, and languages, with at least 50 containing handwritten remarks.
units.quote:
Jari: send anonymised sample of 200 freight documents (mix of types, sites, languages, at least
    50 with handwritten remarks) - by 30 October 2026.

units.summary: Jari is to export daily WMS volumes per site for 2020–2026 and the TMS document log for 2025.
units.quote:
Jari: export daily WMS volumes per site 2020-2026 and the TMS document log for 2025 - by
    30 October 2026.

units.summary: Mikko is to collect current clerk time per document type through a one-week time study in Vantaa.
units.quote: Mikko: collect current clerk time per document type (one-week time study in Vantaa).

units.summary: The next meeting is scheduled for 12 November 2026 on-site in Vantaa to review sample documents and data.
units.quote: Next meeting: 12 November 2026, on-site in Vantaa, to review sample documents and data.

units.topic: freight document sample and clerk-entry comparison
units.summary: The advisors requested about 200 anonymised real documents, including a mix of types, sites, and languages and at least 50 with handwritten remarks; they also requested, if possible, the clerks' entries for comparison.
units.quote: For the document pilot, a sample of about 200 real documents, anonymized, a mix of types, sites, and languages, and at least 50 with handwritten remarks. And if possible, what the clerks actually entered for those documents, so we can compare. I can do that by the end of October.

units.summary: The recording says the requested WMS data is daily site volumes since 2020 and refers to a “DMS document log” for 2025.
units.quote: And the WMS daily volumes per site since 2020, plus the DMS document log for 2025.

units.summary: Mikko is to conduct a one-week time study in Vantaa to establish how long each document type takes.
units.quote: I'll also do a one-week time study in Van Tat, so we know exactly how long each document type takes.

units.summary: The participants agreed to meet on 12 November, on-site in Vantaa.
units.quote: How about the 12th of November? The 12th of November works for us.

units.summary: The advisors said their services are free up to a limit of hours and that they would give advance notice if they approached that limit.
units.quote: our advisory services are free of charge up to a certain number of hours, and we'll let you know well in advance if we get close to that limit.

conflicts.description: The meeting notes specify the TMS document log for 2025 (unit 10), while the recording refers to the DMS document log for 2025 (unit 13). The instructions give no source priority to resolve this difference.
